description: An object at a version, as world-object answers it to a reader who may view the object.

main.description: Record key: `<object>/<version>`. The record's cid is `stateCid`, the CID of the state at that version as the journal names it (a write's `writes[].cid`, or a created seed).

pin.description: The CID of the object's sealed source closure at that version (content name).

law.description: The law text at that version.

readings.description: The package's reading of each clause it gave one.

laws.description: The law's clauses, each a town.delvetalk.law record.

library.description: The pin of the library the object compiles under (`library.pin`).
